# Self-Describing Deliverable

## Purpose
This folder should explain itself.

A new human or agent should be able to infer:
- what EMA is
- what is canon vs planning vs reality vs gap
- how to navigate the work
- which tracks exist
- which imports influenced the design
- how code vApp / host ops / graph knowledge fit together
